SRC-369:R010.text: Enter event-driven quiescence only when no eligible work remains. A drained queue is not a satisfied persistent goal. A locally passing focused suite is not a clean release gate. A published remote SHA matching an expected SHA does not establish that every newer pending cohort has shipped. RELEASE Compare the exact intended release cohort and expected commit to the actual remote branch. If they already match, record that verified synchronization instead of repeatedly attempting a no-op release. If newer reviewed changes remain pending, prepare a safe isolated release and request exact broker permission only when genuinely necessary. Preserve foreign staging and all publication gates. Do not let release waiting suppress unrelated authorized engineering. VERIFICATION The earlier full-suite mass failure was attributed primarily to a router NameError. Verify the repair under the current exact source generation. Use focused tests during implementation and the required broader acceptance gate at its actual boundary. Do not present 52 focused PASS as proof of a completely clean full suite. LIVE AUTONOMY Verify actual successive model turns, actual task execution, durable goal progress, restart recovery and automatic resumption. Log actual execution receipts, not just hook events or model claims. EXPECTED RESULT At least one registered, appropriately authorized persistent goal with a functioning discovery provider. One genuine evidence-backed maintenance candidate admitted and handled. Independent verification of its outcome. Correct continuation or legitimate event-driven quiescence. No new framework. No fake goal satisfaction. No invented grant. No repetitive status polling. No premature campaign completion.
